mapper.insert: INSERT INTO repository_markdown_sources( id,repo_id,branch_id,content_version,file_path,content_hash,title,asset_type,content,line_count,byte_size ) SELECT #{id},#{repositoryId},b.id,#{contentVersion},#{filePath},#{contentHash},#{title},#{assetType}, #{content},#{lineCount},#{byteSize} FROM repository_branches b JOIN repositories r ON r.id=b.repo_id WHERE b.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND b.name=COALESCE(r.default_branch,'WORKSPACE') ON CONFLICT(repo_id,branch_id,file_path) DO UPDATE SET content_version=EXCLUDED.content_version, content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash, title=EXCLUDED.title, asset_type=EXCLUDED.asset_type, content=EXCLUDED.content, line_count=EXCLUDED.line_count, byte_size=EXCLUDED.byte_size, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.sql: s.id source_id, s.branch_id source_branch_id, s.content_version source_content_version, s.file_path source_path, s.content_hash source_content_hash, s.title, s.asset_type, s.line_count, s.byte_size, CASE WHEN latest.card_id IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' WHEN latest.source_content_hash=s.content_hash THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'STALE' END source_status, latest.card_id, latest.card_revision, latest.source_content_version generated_content_version, latest.source_content_hash generated_content_hash

LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.card_id,c.revision card_revision,l.source_content_version,l.source_content_hash FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN knowledge_cards c ON c.id=l.card_id AND c.repo_id=l.repo_id WHERE l.repo_id=s.repo_id AND l.source_branch_id=s.branch_id AND l.source_path=s.file_path ORDER BY l.generated_at DESC,l.revision DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM repository_markdown_sources s
WHERE s.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND s.content_version=#{contentVersion} ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest.card_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN latest.source_content_hash<>s.content_hash THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.file_path

SELECT FROM repository_markdown_sources s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.card_id,c.revision card_revision,l.source_content_version,l.source_content_hash FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN knowledge_cards c ON c.id=l.card_id AND c.repo_id=l.repo_id WHERE l.repo_id=s.repo_id AND l.source_branch_id=s.branch_id AND l.source_path=s.file_path ORDER BY l.generated_at DESC,l.revision DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE WHERE s.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND s.branch_id=#{branchId} AND s.content_version=#{contentVersion} ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest.card_id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN latest.source_content_hash<>s.content_hash THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,s.file_path

SELECT ,s.content FROM repository_markdown_sources s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.card_id,c.revision card_revision,l.source_content_version,l.source_content_hash FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN knowledge_cards c ON c.id=l.card_id AND c.repo_id=l.repo_id WHERE l.repo_id=s.repo_id AND l.source_branch_id=s.branch_id AND l.source_path=s.file_path ORDER BY l.generated_at DESC,l.revision DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE WHERE s.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND s.branch_id=#{branchId} AND s.content_version=#{contentVersion} AND s.file_path=#{filePath}

SELECT s.id source_id,s.content_version source_content_version,s.file_path source_path, s.content_hash source_content_hash,s.title,s.asset_type,s.content,s.line_count,s.byte_size, r.current_content_version repository_content_version FROM repository_markdown_sources s JOIN repositories r ON r.id=s.repo_id WHERE s.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND s.file_path=#{filePath} AND s.branch_id=( SELECT b.id FROM repository_branches b JOIN repositories r ON r.id=b.repo_id WHERE b.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND b.name=COALESCE(r.default_branch,'WORKSPACE') ) FOR UPDATE OF s,r

SELECT s.id source_id,s.branch_id source_branch_id,s.content_version source_content_version, s.file_path source_path,s.content_hash source_content_hash,s.title,s.asset_type, s.content,s.line_count,s.byte_size,b.content_version repository_content_version FROM repository_markdown_sources s JOIN repository_branches b ON b.repo_id=s.repo_id AND b.id=s.branch_id WHERE s.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND s.branch_id=#{branchId} AND s.file_path=#{filePath} FOR UPDATE OF s,b
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_branch_validations( card_id,revision,branch_id,content_version,state,note,checked_at ) SELECT l.card_id,l.revision,#{branchId},#{contentVersion}, CASE WHEN l.source_content_hash=s.content_hash THEN 'UNVERIFIED' ELSE 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' END, CASE WHEN l.source_content_hash=s.content_hash THEN 'Markdown 来源内容未变化；该内容版本仍需独立确认适用性' ELSE 'Markdown 来源内容已变化，请复核知识修订' END, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN repository_markdown_sources s ON s.repo_id=l.repo_id AND s.branch_id=l.source_branch_id AND s.file_path=l.source_path WHERE l.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND l.source_branch_id=#{branchId} AND s.content_version=#{contentVersion} AND l.revision=(SELECT MAX(newer.revision) FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links newer WHERE newer.card_id=l.card_id) ON CONFLICT(card_id,revision,branch_id,content_version) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_cards c SET verified_commit=CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN repository_markdown_sources s ON s.repo_id=l.repo_id AND s.branch_id=l.source_branch_id AND s.file_path=l.source_path WHERE l.card_id=c.id AND l.revision=( SELECT MAX(newer.revision) FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links newer WHERE newer.card_id=c.id ) AND s.content_hash=l.source_content_hash ) THEN #{commitSha,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ELSE c.verified_commit END, source_version_status=CASE WHEN EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN repository_markdown_sources s ON s.repo_id=l.repo_id AND s.branch_id=l.source_branch_id AND s.file_path=l.source_path WHERE l.card_id=c.id AND l.revision=( SELECT MAX(newer.revision) FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links newer WHERE newer.card_id=c.id ) AND s.content_hash=l.source_content_hash ) THEN CASE WHEN #{commitAvailable} THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'UNVERIFIED' END ELSE 'STALE' END, source_version_checked_at=CASE WHEN #{commitAvailable} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN repository_markdown_sources s ON s.repo_id=l.repo_id AND s.branch_id=l.source_branch_id AND s.file_path=l.source_path WHERE l.card_id=c.id AND l.revision=( SELECT MAX(newer.revision) FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links newer WHERE newer.card_id=c.id ) AND s.content_hash=l.source_content_hash ) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, last_verified_content_version=CASE WHEN #{commitAvailable} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN repository_markdown_sources s ON s.repo_id=l.repo_id AND s.branch_id=l.source_branch_id AND s.file_path=l.source_path WHERE l.card_id=c.id AND l.revision=( SELECT MAX(newer.revision) FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links newer WHERE newer.card_id=c.id ) AND s.content_hash=l.source_content_hash ) THEN #{contentVersion} ELSE c.last_verified_content_version END, verification_note=CASE WHEN #{commitAvailable} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links l JOIN repository_markdown_sources s ON s.repo_id=l.repo_id AND s.branch_id=l.source_branch_id AND s.file_path=l.source_path WHERE l.card_id=c.id AND l.revision=( SELECT MAX(newer.revision) FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links newer WHERE newer.card_id=c.id ) AND s.content_hash=l.source_content_hash ) THEN 'Markdown 来源内容哈希已在当前内容版本中核验' ELSE c.verification_note END WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_card_markdown_source_links linked WHERE linked.card_id=c.id AND linked.repo_id=#{repositoryId} )
